title: Muto Runtime: Dynamic Bytecode Hot-Swapping & Classloader Isolation in Modded JVMs
description: The agony of mod development: change two lines of code, wait three minutes for Minecraft to launch. How we engineered classloader re-anchoring, bytecode un-weaving, and ephemeral child-first classloaders to hot-swap jars in under 200ms inside a running Fabric instance.
